form.subtitle: ICMP, TCP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SNMP devices are checked automatically after they are saved.
form.name: Name
form.pathHint: If the host is not a full URL, HTTPS plus this path is used. Example: /health
form.communityHint: Read-only community string. Stored only on this computer.
form.oidHint: Default is sysUpTime (1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0). A successful GET means Online.

settings.title: Monitoring settings
settings.subtitle: These values are used as defaults for new devices.
settings.languageHint: The interface language changes immediately. The app does not need to restart.
settings.thresholdHint: The device is marked Offline after this many consecutive failed checks.
settings.applyToExisting: Also apply to all existing devices

email.title: Email settings
email.subtitle: Offline and recovery alerts are sent through your SMTP server. The password is stored only on this computer.
email.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
email.notifyDown: Notify when a device goes Offline
email.notifyUp: Notify when a device is Online again
